Enter an expression and press Calculate.
Invalid expression. Check the supported names, numbers, operators and parentheses.
Expression exceeds a limit: 512 characters, 512 tokens or 32 nested operations.
The expression is outside the supported real-number domain. Zero to the power zero and tangent at or extremely near a pole are not defined here.
Division by zero is not allowed.
The result or an intermediate value exceeds the finite numeric range.
The saved expression or angle mode is invalid. Your current inputs were kept.
Operators: +, -, *, /, ^ and parentheses. Use explicit multiplication: 2*pi, not 2pi. Powers associate right: 2^3^2 = 512. Unary minus follows powers: -2^2 = -4; (-2)^2 = 4.
Functions (lowercase, parentheses required): sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan, sqrt, ln, log, abs, exp. ln is natural log; log is base 10. Constants: pi and e. Example: sqrt(9)+sin(30).
Use a decimal point and no digit separators. Scientific notation is supported: 1.5e3 or 2E-4. Write 2*e for twice the constant e; 2e alone is invalid.
The selected angle unit applies to sin/cos/tan inputs and asin/acos/atan outputs. Other functions are unaffected.
Uses finite double-precision arithmetic, not exact symbolic algebra. Rounding, underflow to zero and loss of accuracy for very large angles are possible. Complex numbers are not supported.

Editing or explicit imports clears the result; Calculate is required again. Remember results can reconstruct a completed calculation when reopening. Saved modes retain only DEG/RAD, not the expression.
